title: securer 0.1.0
text: macOS: Full OS-level sandbox via Seatbelt (sandbox-exec) - filesystem writes blocked, network denied, reads restricted R libraries. Linux: Full namespace isolation via bubblewrap (bwrap) - read-mounts, network namespace isolation, /tmp-writes. Windows: Environment variable isolation (clean HOME, empty R_LIBS_USER) plus Job Object resource limits (memory, CPU time, process count) via PowerShell.
